title: Recursive Bubble Sort
intuition: One recursive call = one bubble pass that places the next maximum at the end; then recurse on n−1. Same O(n²) — recursion is pedagogical, not an asymptotic win.

approaches.title: Recursive bubble
approaches.idea: Bubble pass on a[0..n-1], then recurse with n-1.
limitations: Worse constants than iterative; stack depth n

interviewInsight: Show you can rewrite loops as recursion without changing big-O.
